title: Membership in the SAT-to-3-SAT encoding
statement: Let $f = (C_0, \dots, C_{m-1})$ be a CNF formula over a variable type $V$, and write $\mathrm{Aux}(V)$ for the auxiliary variable type built from $V$. For each index $i$ with $0 \le i < m$, let $T_i$ be the list of $3$-clauses obtained by encoding the single clause $C_i$ at index $i$, and take the SAT-to-3-SAT encoding of $f$ to be the $3$-CNF formula over $\mathrm{Aux}(V)$ formed by concatenating $T_0, T_1, \dots, T_{m-1}$ in order. Then a $3$-clause $c$ over $\mathrm{Aux}(V)$ occurs in the SAT-to-3-SAT encoding of $f$ if and only if there exists an index $i < m$ such that $c$ occurs in $T_i$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a CNF formula over a variable type V
c is a 3-clause over the auxiliary variable type built from V
existence of an index i with i < m (the number of clauses of f)
c occurs in the single-clause encoding of the i-th clause at index i
replaced:
A 3-clause $c_3$ belongs to $\texttt{SATTo3SAT.to3SAT}\,f$ if and only if there exists
$i < |f|$ such that $c_3$ belongs to $\texttt{SATTo3SAT.transformClause}\,i\,(f_i)$.
